value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym Sundays 9:30-10:15am, Sept 14-Oct 26, $124 (plus $25 membership) for walking-3.5yrs with a parent - their site says. They also list Kinderfun, Saturdays 10:30-11:15am, Sept 13-Oct 25, $145, drop-off for 3-5yrs. Fall registration has been open since July 22, open until classes fill.
